en:
My hair bristles,
lifting my helm.
I lean on the rail;
the rain has ceased.
I raise my eyes
and roar to the sky,
my heart ablaze.
Thirty years' glory:
mere dust and dirt.
Eight thousand li
of cloud and moon.
Waste no time,
lest a young head
turn white, and then
you grieve in vain.
Jingkang's shame
is not yet avenged;
a subject's wrath -
when will it end?
Our chariots shall
break Helan's pass!
Hungry, I'll feast
on invaders' flesh;
laughing, I'll drink
the Xiongnu's blood.
Let us start afresh,
win back our lands,
and report to court!

At the summit of Mt. Hua, the Eastern Heretic, Western Venom, Southern Emperor, Northern Beggar and Qiu Qianren are locked in a contest of internal energy.

Qiu Qianren, at odds with Guo Jing, challenges him to a duel; Guo Jing holds that a former Jin lackey has no right to the Mount Hua Summit. Once Qiu is beaten, Hong Qigong and Huang Yaoshi both declare Guo Jing's kung fu the best in the world.
But Ouyang Feng refuses to accept it, and Guo Jing won't let him become the best in the world. You join the fight.
After a desperate battle, Ouyang Feng is beaten out of his wits and runs off babbling in Sanskrit.
Guo Jing: Thank you for your help. Take this Nine Yin Manual. Whether you can grasp its secrets is up to you.
Oh! So that's how it works. What a marvelous book!
